design.selection: Cases 01 through 03 of each behavior task, both option orders, clean prompt condition.
design.perturbation: Swap one unequal adjacent interior letter pair inside a word of length >=4 in the work order. Sample five offsets without replacement, seeded by case ID; reuse those offsets for both orderings.
design.vote: Three or more identical parsed letters out of five. A missing majority is unscored and counts against accuracy. Every presentation is included.
